scientific_limitations_and_integrity.claim_scope: Existence of a positive nonincreasing sequence with superexponential decay and arbitrarily large a-bounded triangle-free complete-graph colourings.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.integrity: The mathematical proof and cited dependencies are stated explicitly; no independent audit or independent validation is claimed.
limitations: The threshold j0 and the base colourings are existential rather than explicitly enumerated.
No optimality claim is made for the exponent 1/8.
The result does not classify all Decay-Ramsey sequences.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.proof_dependency: Uses the published lower bound \(R_j(3)\ge j^{j/3-o(j)}\) to guarantee base colourings for all sufficiently large \(j\).

title: Superexponentially decaying colour budgets can avoid monochromatic triangles
